Q: pyright fails parsing TypeForm for Unions with embedded containers A:

This is a Pyright-specific bug and is reducible to the type checker not making UnionType assignable to TypeForm in general. The following example type checks under mypy, ty, Zuban, and Pyrefly, but not Pyright:

from typing_extensions import TypeForm

unparameterized: TypeForm = object | None
parameterized: TypeForm[object] = object | None

I've opened a bug report on the Pyright repo.

Q: How to cleanly make a function which takes any combination of optional parameters in C++? A:

I prefer (but don't insist) when people use params{} so it is easy to spot that this is a type rather than a function call.

Q: How to create a custom dimension in Firebase Analytics A:

There aren't custom dimensions in new Property. The focus was specifically on custom parameters. They are the analogy with Custom Dimensions and Custom Metrics in Google Analytics Universal.

https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/9478675?hl=en

Q: Nodemon: Error: listen EADDRINUSE: address already in use :::5000 A:

Here's the best combination of package.json scripts that works for me on macOS, currently about 80% of the time:

"start": "node app.js",
"dev": "nodemon --delay 500ms --exec \"npm run kill && npm start\"",
"kill": "lsof -t -i:5000 | xargs -r kill -9 || true",

When I see the EADDRINUSE error, I just re-save the file and it works the second time.
